content:
Last month, OpenAI teased a hardware product under the Codex brand. Today, the company officially launched the result of its collaboration with Work Louder: a Codex Micro keyboard priced at US$230.

Here's the product introduction:

The keyboard comes in two versions: a tactile (clicky) version and a silent version.

According to the website: "Each Agent key lights up with RGB effects based on Codex's real-time status, so you can tell at a glance who's thinking, running, waiting, or done before switching conversations."

The product page also lists three Codex-specific features:

  • Instant skill trigger: Flick the joystick to launch common Codex workflows such as reviewing a PR, debugging an error, or refactoring code.
  • Core actions at your fingertips: Command keys offer dedicated shortcuts for the most frequently used actions: accept, reject, talk, start a new conversation, and more. Less switching, more focus on delivery.
  • Adjust compute intensity: Turn the dial to instantly change the reasoning level. Stay efficient on simple tasks, and crank it up when the work calls for deeper thinking.
